PRICING MODEL: Enterprise

- Government program integrity, fraud detection, and payment disbursement

- Spend analytics and accounts payable (AP) recovery services
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Ability to handle massive scale (e.g., $80B in government payments, 2B customer interactions annually) while turning complexity into clarity through integrated people, processes, and technology.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium / Strategic Partner
